about: Generated by conformance/family_oracle (make family-vectors). Do not edit by hand.
Every derived value comes from the independent Python oracle, never from Rust.
Rust tests read the inputs, recompute the outputs, and compare.
The cases are the registered vectors of quip/flow-static revision 1, generated by flow.py.
A case lists the salts that build in its instances and the salts that give code 14 in its skipped list.

The flow_witnesses section holds, for the first instance of each case, a feasible state and an infeasible state with a lower objective. A witness holds one spin per instance node. An entry gives the expected feasible result, the objective, the direct charges, the number of violated labels, the number of reversed links, and the encoded energy in milli. The feasible state of flow-l2 has the lowest objective of all 4096 states. The feasible states of the other cases are the orientations that the draw found. The infeasible state is the lowest objective state that breaks a label at L = 2 and the requested direction of every link otherwise.
The networks section holds, for the first instance of each case, the supplies of the vertices and the tail, head, target, and cost of every link, in vertex order and link order.

The flow_recipes section holds the registered parameter sets on the live z(12, 4) topology with two salts each. It stores hashes, the window, and the boundary try that passed, not instances. A recipe that gives admission code 12 has no salts.
The admission section holds requests with their expected admission codes.
